title: Topic 12 旅行 Travel
japanese_text: <u>豊かな</u><ruby>国<rt>くに</rt></ruby>とよく<ruby>言<rt>い</rt></ruby>われるが、それがどういうことなのか<u>正確</u>に<ruby>言<rt>い</rt></ruby>うのは<ruby>難<rt>むずか</rt></ruby>しい。<ruby>例<rt>たと</rt></ruby>えば、ビルがたくさん建っていれば<ruby>豊<rt>ゆた</rt></ruby>かなのだろうか。GDPという<u>指標</u>がよく<ruby>使<rt>つか</rt></ruby>われ、これはその<ruby>国<rt>くに</rt></ruby>で<ruby>作<rt>つく</rt></ruby>られたものやサービスの<ruby>合計<rt>ごうけい</rt></ruby><ruby>金額<rt>きんがく</rt></ruby>を<u>指す</u>。<u>物価</u>も<ruby>考<rt>かんが</rt></ruby>える<ruby>必要<rt>ひつよう</rt></ruby>がある。
english_translation: We hear a lot about "wealthy nations," but it's difficult to say precisely what that means. For example, is having many buildings what makes a country wealthy? One commonly-used index is GDP, which indicates the total monetary value of everything that was manufactured, services, and the like in that country. Prices also need to be considered.
